turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Welcome back to the garden show. Today we are planting tomatoes.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Thanks for having me. I brought three kinds of seedlings.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Which one grows best on a small balcony?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: The cherry tomato, because it stays compact and fruits early.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Perfect. Let us put them in the pots right now.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Water them gently, and keep them in the sun.
